title: Turn
description: JSON Schema for a turn — one round of inference in a session. Captures the user message, the assistant response, the tool calls between, model identity, timings, token counts, and stop reason. Specializes thing via allOf; identity is the turn-id (a kebab-case name).

session.description: The session-id this turn belongs to.

started-at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the turn opened (user message received).

ended-at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the turn closed (assistant response complete).

user-message.description: The user's input for this turn. Full text or content-address.

assistant-message.description: The assistant's response for this turn. Full text or content-address.

tool-calls.description: Ordered list of tool calls the assistant made during this turn.

input-tokens.description: Input token count for the assistant response, if reported by the inference-model.

output-tokens.description: Output token count for the assistant response, if reported.

stop-reason.description: The reason the inference-model stopped: end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence, tool_use, refusal, etc.
